premises.text: Retail shippers of diverse real items cannot easily get packing and shipping costs across fragmented carrier markets that only quote boxed freight
premises.evidence_span: It's a problem because it's so hard to determine what it costs to pack and ship something

premises.text: ShipHawk aggregates carriers and converts real items into packed weights and dimensions for instant multi-carrier packing and shipping quotes
premises.evidence_span: we have aggregated all of these different markets into one website

premises.text: Users can schedule pickup or drop off at network locations and complete pay/label in minutes, including local delivery
premises.evidence_span: you get to schedule a pickup at your home or office

premises.text: Revenue is commission from shipping, packing, insurance, and other service providers sent business
premises.evidence_span: ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

value.text: Shipping any real-world item becomes as easy and comparable as booking travel
value.evidence_span: we are to shipping what kayak is to travel

causal_links.evidence_span: None of these guys will give you quotes unless your item is in a box
instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes
collecting a commission from all the service providers

notes: Micro-niche retailer pains and carrier fragmentation folded as one quoting problem (§4.1.6). Aggregate markets, item-to-dimensions conversion, multi-carrier options, pickup/dropoff/labels folded as platform cascade (§4.1.7). Founder shipping-company bio excluded. Anti-template: problem, platform, and commissions separately revisable.
